name: Berka Triade
source:
"Hey. If you're going to fight, can I join you?"

- Affiliation: Pegasus Class
- Birthday: September 30
- Height: 166 cm
- Three Size: B85(C)/W62/H83
- Likes: Strong enemies
- Dislikes: Enemies of beauty
- Will/Gem: "A Thousand Feathers, A Thousand Cuts" Alexandrite Sword
A power that prides itself on "not losing to anyone when it comes to swordsmanship". All the abilities necessary for sword fights are sharpened, including awareness, sharpness, and judgment. At the end of the day, she is able to reach a state of being like a sixth sense.

She is a classmate of the Pegasus Class who has sharp sense and sporty.
She is enrolls to the Jewerly Academia to master the art of swordsmanship.
Despite her beautiful appearance that even her own gender is attracted to, she is a very self-paced girl who shows no interest in anything other than "fighting strong opponents and winning".

[Translated from [url=https://cabbage-soft.com/products/jewelry/character/]Official Website[/url]]
